summary_en: TOPPAN Holdings will sell all 10.45 million artience shares (22.28% stake) in a self-tender offer by artience at 4,383 yen per share for approximately 45.8 billion yen, expected to recognize special gains of 3.0 billion yen in consolidated results and 34.9 billion yen in standalone results for the fiscal year ending March 2027.
title_en: Notice regarding Subscription to artience Inc.'s Self-Tender Offer and Recording of Gain on Sale of Equity Investments
translation_en_brief:
On November 13, 2026, TOPPAN Holdings announced that it will submit all 10.45 million ordinary shares of artience Inc. (representing a 22.28% stake) to a self-tender offer initiated by artience. The purchase price is set at 4,383 yen per share, valuing the transaction at approximately 45.8 billion yen. The tender offer period runs from November 16, 2026 to December 14, 2026, with settlement expected to begin on January 7, 2027.

Following completion of the sale, TOPPAN will no longer hold any shares in artience and the company will cease to be an associated company accounted for using the equity method. The transaction is part of TOPPAN's balance sheet reform initiatives outlined in its Medium-Term Management Plan 2028 (announced in May 2026). Management determined that the purchase price and transaction terms are reasonable after discussions with artience regarding the handling of the shares.

If all tendered shares are purchased, TOPPAN expects to record a gain on sale of related company shares of approximately 3.0 billion yen in consolidated results and approximately 34.9 billion yen in standalone results for the fiscal year ending March 31, 2027. Both TOPPAN and artience have agreed to maintain a strong partnership as independent business partners, with cooperation based on the competitiveness of products and services and synergies from collaboration, independent of the equity ownership structure.
